premises.text: Diabetes requires constant blood-sugar management because food, activity, medication, stress, and even weather affect sugar
premises.evidence_span: everything affects my sugar. from food, activity, medication, the stress of tech crunch disrupt, and even the weather

premises.text: Existing diabetes apps mainly add fancy logging tools that still force hard manual analysis

premises.text: Spike automatically collects routine, activity, and vitals to give proactive insulin tips, reminders, and food suggestions before incidents

premises.text: Supported patches and glucometers automatically supply readings that can be compared with other connected signals
premises.evidence_span: Supporting more than 10 other glucometers spike would automatically get a reading
